admins_disabled_at_check.name: admins_disabled_at_check
admins_disabled_at_check.value: (status = 'DISABLED' AND disabled_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'DISABLED' AND disabled_at IS NULL)

discounts_currency_check.name: discounts_currency_check
discounts_currency_check.value: currency IS NULL OR currency IN ('IRT', 'IRR', 'USD', 'EUR', 'USDT')

discounts_percentage_check.name: discounts_percentage_check
discounts_percentage_check.value: type <> 'PERCENTAGE' OR (value <= 100 AND currency IS NULL)

discounts_fixed_check.name: discounts_fixed_check
discounts_fixed_check.value: type <> 'FIXED_AMOUNT' OR currency IS NOT NULL

discounts_window_check.name: discounts_window_check
discounts_window_check.value: starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at IS NULL OR starts_at < ends_at

discounts_limits_check.name: discounts_limits_check
discounts_limits_check.value: (total_redemptions_limit IS NULL OR total_redemptions_limit > 0) AND (per_customer_limit IS NULL OR per_customer_limit > 0)

notification_delivery_attempts_error_che.name: notification_delivery_attempts_error_check
notification_delivery_attempts_error_che.value: (outcome = 'SUCCEEDED' AND error_code IS NULL) OR (outcome <> 'SUCCEEDED' AND error_code IS NOT NULL)

notifications_completed_check.name: notifications_completed_check
notifications_completed_check.value: (status = 'PENDING' AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'PENDING' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

operational_events_resolution_check.name: operational_events_resolution_check
operational_events_resolution_check.value: resolved_by_event_id IS NULL OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL

orders_quantity_line_check.name: orders_quantity_line_check
orders_quantity_line_check.value:
purpose NOT IN ('ADD_TRAFFIC', 'ADD_TIME')
          OR (purpose = 'ADD_TRAFFIC' AND line_traffic_bytes > 0 AND line_duration_days = 0)
          OR (purpose = 'ADD_TIME' AND line_duration_days > 0 AND line_traffic_bytes = 0)

panel_credentials_username_check.name: panel_credentials_username_check
panel_credentials_username_check.value:
(username_ciphertext IS NULL) = (username_key_id IS NULL)
          AND (username_ciphertext IS NULL) = (username_set_at IS NULL)

panel_credentials_password_check.name: panel_credentials_password_check
panel_credentials_password_check.value:
(password_ciphertext IS NULL) = (password_key_id IS NULL)
          AND (password_ciphertext IS NULL) = (password_set_at IS NULL)

panel_credentials_api_token_check.name: panel_credentials_api_token_check
panel_credentials_api_token_check.value:
(api_token_ciphertext IS NULL) = (api_token_key_id IS NULL)
          AND (api_token_ciphertext IS NULL) = (api_token_set_at IS NULL)

panel_health_failure_check.name: panel_health_failure_check
panel_health_failure_check.value: failure IS NULL OR failure IN ('AUTHENTICATION_FAILED', 'AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRES_INTERACTION', 'UNREACHABLE', 'TIMEOUT', 'TLS_FAILED', 'BLOCKED_TARGET', 'RATE_LIMITED', 'MALFORMED_RESPONSE', 'PROVIDER_ERROR', 'UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY')

panel_monitor_schedule_deferred_reason_c.name: panel_monitor_schedule_deferred_reason_check
panel_monitor_schedule_deferred_reason_c.value: deferred_reason IS NULL OR deferred_reason IN ('CREDENTIALS_MISSING', 'TARGET_BLOCKED', 'STATUS_NOT_PROBEABLE', 'COOLDOWN', 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED', 'NOT_AUTHORIZED', 'CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED', 'INTERNAL_ERROR')

payment_gateways_bounds_currency_check.name: payment_gateways_bounds_currency_check
payment_gateways_bounds_currency_check.value: bounds_currency IS NULL OR bounds_currency IN ('IRT', 'IRR', 'USD', 'EUR', 'USDT')

payment_gateways_payment_window_check.name: payment_gateways_payment_window_check
payment_gateways_payment_window_check.value:
activate_after_payments = 0
          OR deactivate_after_payments = 0
          OR deactivate_after_payments > activate_after_payments

payment_gateways_thresholds_check.name: payment_gateways_thresholds_check
payment_gateways_thresholds_check.value:
activate_after_payments BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
          AND deactivate_after_payments BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
          AND activate_after_account_days BETWEEN 0 AND 100000

payment_gateways_display_name_check.name: payment_gateways_display_name_check
payment_gateways_display_name_check.value: display_name IS NULL OR length(btrim(display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60

payment_gateways_instructions_check.name: payment_gateways_instructions_check
payment_gateways_instructions_check.value: instructions IS NULL OR length(instructions) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

payments_order_confirmed_key.name: payments_order_confirmed_key
payments_order_confirmed_key.where: state = 'CONFIRMED' AND order_id IS NOT NULL

payments_open_topup_key.name: payments_open_topup_key
payments_open_topup_key.where: state = 'PENDING' AND order_id IS NULL AND method = 'MANUAL_TRANSFER'

payments_evidence_kind_check.name: payments_evidence_kind_check
payments_evidence_kind_check.value: evidence_kind IS NULL OR evidence_kind IN ('OPERATOR_REVIEW', 'WALLET_DEBIT', 'GATEWAY_CALLBACK', 'RECONCILIATION')

payments_confirmed_check.name: payments_confirmed_check
payments_confirmed_check.value: (state = 'CONFIRMED') = (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND evidence_kind IS NOT NULL)

payments_resolution_note_check.name: payments_resolution_note_check
payments_resolution_note_check.value: resolution_note IS NULL OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL

products_price_currency_check.name: products_price_currency_check
products_price_currency_check.value: price_currency IS NULL OR price_currency IN ('IRT', 'IRR', 'USD', 'EUR', 'USDT')

provisioning_operations_failure_kind_che.name: provisioning_operations_failure_kind_check
provisioning_operations_failure_kind_che.value: failure_kind IS NULL OR failure_kind IN ('AUTHENTICATION_FAILED', 'AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRES_INTERACTION', 'UNREACHABLE', 'TIMEOUT', 'TLS_FAILED', 'BLOCKED_TARGET', 'RATE_LIMITED', 'MALFORMED_RESPONSE', 'PROVIDER_ERROR', 'UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY')

provisioning_operations_target_check.name: provisioning_operations_target_check
provisioning_operations_target_check.value:
type IN ('RENEW', 'ADD_TRAFFIC', 'ADD_TIME')
          OR (target_expires_at IS NULL AND target_traffic_limit_bytes IS NULL)

provisioning_operations_target_present_c.name: provisioning_operations_target_present_check
provisioning_operations_target_present_c.value:
type NOT IN ('RENEW', 'ADD_TRAFFIC', 'ADD_TIME')
          OR target_expires_at IS NOT NULL
          OR target_traffic_limit_bytes IS NOT NULL

receipt_captures_close_reason_check.name: receipt_captures_close_reason_check
receipt_captures_close_reason_check.value: close_reason IS NULL OR close_reason IN ('RECEIVED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'EXPIRED')

recovery_requests_failure_code_check.name: recovery_requests_failure_code_check
recovery_requests_failure_code_check.value: failure_code IS NULL OR failure_code IN ('recovery.upload_rejected', 'recovery.archive_malformed', 'recovery.archive_auth_failed', 'recovery.archive_foreign_key', 'recovery.checksum_mismatch', 'recovery.manifest_invalid', 'recovery.restore_test_failed', 'recovery.restored_database_empty', 'recovery.migration_state_unreadable', 'recovery.migration_incompatible', 'recovery.confirmation_invalid', 'recovery.emergency_backup_failed', 'recovery.emergency_backup_busy', 'recovery.quiesce_failed', 'recovery.candidate_create_failed', 'recovery.candidate_restore_failed', 'recovery.candidate_validation_failed', 'recovery.cutover_failed', 'recovery.readiness_failed', 'recovery.lease_expired', 'recovery.internal')

recovery_requests_cutover_check.name: recovery_requests_cutover_check
recovery_requests_cutover_check.value: cutover_at IS NULL OR displaced_database IS NOT NULL

refunds_external_reference_check.name: refunds_external_reference_check
refunds_external_reference_check.value: external_reference IS NULL OR length(btrim(external_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 140

refunds_operator_completion_check.name: refunds_operator_completion_check
refunds_operator_completion_check.value: (state = 'COMPLETED' AND requested_by_admin_id IS NOT NULL) = (completed_by_admin_id IS NOT NULL)

resellers_discount_range_check.name: resellers_discount_range_check
resellers_discount_range_check.value: discount_percentage IS NULL OR (discount_percentage >= 1 AND discount_percentage <= 100)

service_addons_price_currency_check.name: service_addons_price_currency_check
service_addons_price_currency_check.value: price_currency IS NULL OR price_currency IN ('IRT', 'IRR', 'USD', 'EUR', 'USDT')

service_addons_amount_matches_kind.name: service_addons_amount_matches_kind
service_addons_amount_matches_kind.value:
(kind = 'ADD_TRAFFIC' AND traffic_bytes IS NOT NULL AND traffic_bytes > 0 AND duration_days IS NULL)
          OR (kind = 'ADD_TIME' AND duration_days IS NOT NULL AND duration_days > 0 AND traffic_bytes IS NULL)

service_commercial_actions_purchased_che.name: service_commercial_actions_purchased_check
service_commercial_actions_purchased_che.value:
(kind = 'RENEW')
          OR (kind = 'ADD_TRAFFIC' AND purchased_traffic_bytes > 0 AND purchased_duration_days = 0)
          OR (kind = 'ADD_TIME' AND purchased_duration_days > 0 AND purchased_traffic_bytes = 0)

services_provisioned_at_check.name: services_provisioned_at_check
services_provisioned_at_check.value:
state = 'TERMINATED'
          OR (state = 'PENDING_PROVISION' OR state = 'UNRECONCILED') = (provisioned_at IS NULL)

services_usage_synced_check.name: services_usage_synced_check
services_usage_synced_check.value: traffic_used_bytes = 0 OR usage_synced_at IS NOT NULL

template_revisions_body_check.name: template_revisions_body_check
template_revisions_body_check.value: (action = 'SET' AND body IS NOT NULL AND length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) OR (action = 'REVERT' AND body IS NULL)

tenants_parent_check.name: tenants_parent_check
tenants_parent_check.value: (kind = 'PRIMARY' AND parent_tenant_id IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'PRIMARY' AND parent_tenant_id IS NOT NULL)

wallet_entries_topup_payment_check.name: wallet_entries_topup_payment_check
wallet_entries_topup_payment_check.value: reason <> 'TOPUP_RECEIPT' OR payment_id IS NOT NULL
